Network Technology Case Studies Fact Sheets and Guides Reports Glossary Trackers and Dashboards Webinars Start Here Digital Opportunity Lab Start a Community Network Sign Up For a Network Educate Your Local Community Subscribe Donate Rethinking the Internet with Bob Frankston - Episode 640 of the Community Broadband Bits Podcast By Jordan Pittman on Mar 18, 2025 In this episode of the podcast, Chris is joined by Bob Frankston, a pioneer in home networking and co-creator of VisiCalc, to explore the evolution of Internet infrastructure. Frankston challenges the conventional understanding of networking, arguing that the Internet should be treated as a public utility rather than a commodity. He reflects on the origins of home networking, the rise of broadband, and why the current telecommunications model is fundamentally broken. Frankston advocates for a future where connectivity is treated like roads and sidewalks—open, abundant, and community-owned. Tune in for a deep dive into how shifting the business model of broadband could unlock new opportunities for innovation and resilience.
